Title: General availability: ExpressRoute now supports Azure Virtual Desktop Shortpath RDP over Private Peering

Body.Content:
ExpressRoute Private Peering now supports Azure Virtual Desktop RDP Shortpath. Azure Virtual Desktop allows you to deploy secure scalable Azure-based virtualization solutions. After establishing the reverse connect transport, the client and session host starts the RDP connection. With RDP Shortpath configured, the client will require a direct connectivity with the session host to establish a secure TLS connection. You can leverage ExpressRoute Private peering to setup the direct connection to support RDP Shortpath. 

Learn more about ExpressRoute. 

Learn more about Azure Virtual Desktop RDP Shortpath.
